The JWT payload identifies the user by username, not by numeric id.
JWT access tokens are signed with the symmetric HS256 algorithm.
A separate per-user salt column is prepended to the password before hashing.
Passwords are hashed with bcrypt through a passlib CryptContext.
Creating an article whose slug already exists is rejected with HTTP 400 instead of making the slug unique.
An article slug is derived from its title with slugify, and recomputed when the title changes.
